actual: After backend restart, Phase 3 HTTP routes and production schema are healthy, but the registered backend tool qe_archive_query_long_trend_quality is absent from backend/mcp/tool_manifest.py and the standalone QE Archive MCP wrapper. Gateway search returns zero results, so clients cannot discover or invoke the delivered read-only MCP contract. Fix must synchronize all authoritative MCP surfaces, add direct manifest/wrapper tests, preserve bounded read-only behavior, and introduce no fallback or research gate.
